client_data_signals.operating_hours: 24/7 (contactable); cleaning team operates seven days a week including evenings, weekends and public holidays at no extra charge
customer_process: Initial enquiry by phone (0498 182 989), email (admin@twinkleclean.com.au) or website quote request, stating the service required and preferred contact method
Discuss requirements, priorities, service frequency, property size, access arrangements and any specific concerns; arrange an onsite inspection for larger or ongoing commercial work
Provide a competitive, customised quote covering the recommended cleaning scope, schedule, frequency, pricing and any optional specialist services
On acceptance, confirm the start date, access details and site requirements, then allocate suitable, experienced cleaners
Brief cleaners with clear instructions, checklists and site-specific training; team arrives on time with professional equipment and completes the service to the agreed standard
After the service, respond to feedback or additional requests (email replies typically within one hour during business hours) and run ongoing quality checks for regular clients
success_stories: For a long-term client operating an obstetrics clinic, our team discovered during an evening clean that a kitchen water pipe had burst and water was spreading through the premises. We immediately contacted the client and arranged emergency flood restoration overnight, containing the damage, protecting the clinic and preventing water reaching the tenant downstairs — a situation that could otherwise have caused significant property damage and business disruption.
certifications: Up-to-date police checks for all cleaners
OHS training: manual handling, safe chemical handling and basic first aid
guarantees: 100% Satisfaction Guarantee — corrective cleaning arranged where an agreed-scope area falls short
Bond-back cleaning guarantee for end-of-tenancy work, subject to agreed scope and inspection conditions
client_data_signals.insurance: Public liability insurance ($20M) plus WorkCover cover for staff.
